status: Registered before multi-policy feature construction and fitting
policy_sets: main5, five unique leave-one-out sets, main5 plus Random; equal descriptive weights
scaling: Main: population-SD z scores on common cohort, recomputed for each policy set. Supplemental fixed-main5 scaling for six alternative sets at seed42 K2-8.
budgets: Equal one-third squared-distance budget per RQ; square-root weights. P2 RQ2 halves; P3 RQ2 thirds; other domains unchanged.
ablation: P2/P3 main5 minus Init, K1 and K3-5, seeds42-46. Registered redistribution of RQ1 budget equally to Impact and HHI; algebraic deletion at unchanged remaining weights separately reported.
spatial: Four previously registered geographic quadrants; seed42, K2-8, each primary specification and P2/P3 policy set. Training-only standardization; predict full cohort.
silhouette: Full cohort Euclidean; no sampling. Preserve all labels and individual silhouette values.
elbow: Endpoint chord gap on mean inertia K1-8; relative reduction and fraction K1 removed. Bend is a diagnostic, not automatically selected K.
nonlinear_audit: Five-fold shuffled seed42 additive cubic splines (5 knots) plus Ridge(alpha=1), standardized predictors; out-of-fold R2. Diagnostic predictive overlap, not causal or spatial validation.
upper_tail: P90 PolicySD and top1percent coordinate variance contribution; descriptive thresholds only, never feature eligibility or fit trimming.
label_order: Model-specific display IDs ordered by mean fitted policy total burden, then mean population. Hungarian matching for transitions only; ARI label-invariant.
